Professional, high-fidelity, pixel-perfect web application screenshot. French national data analytics dashboard. Landscape 16:9, 2688x1536 desktop viewport.

DESIGN DIRECTION: DARK MODE PREMIUM. Deep slate background (#1E293B) everywhere. White/light cards floating on dark. Gold (#D4A853) and crimson (#B71C1C) accents. High contrast. Feels like a Bloomberg terminal meets a luxury editorial.

Image 1 is the LIVE APP — extract real data layout. Image 2 is the previous design — keep the same CONTENT and SECTIONS but completely change the color scheme to dark.

HEADER: Dark navy (#0F172A) bar. Left: red shield icon + 'Ouvama France' in white bold. Center: 4 nav tabs in white text: 'Vue d ensemble' (active, gold underline), 'Donnees detaillees', 'Tendances', 'Articles & Actus'. Right: 'TOOLS' button white text.

Breadcrumb on slate: 'France > Ile-de-France > Paris' in muted grey text.

Large white serif title 'Carte du risque national' on dark slate.

TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT (60/40):

LEFT — Card with very dark background (#1A2332) and subtle border:
  Choropleth France map. Departments colored pale gold to deep crimson by risk. White internal borders. Gradient legend bottom-left.

RIGHT — On dark slate:
  Dark card 'INDICES' with gold accent line. 6 rows: colored left accent bars, category names in white, score pills glowing on dark:
    Score Total 113, Insecurite 110, Immigration 142, Islamisation 124, Defrancisation 89, Wokisme 95.

  4 dark KPI cards with subtle glow borders: Score Global 113 +3.2% green, Insecurite 118 +1.1%, Immigration 142 -0.5%, Islamisation 124 +2.1%.

  Two dark cards: Macron portrait + elections 65% with gold/navy stacked bar.

FINAL RULES:
- The ENTIRE page background is deep slate (#1E293B). NOT white. NOT light.
- Cards are dark (#1A2332) with subtle light borders.
- Text is white or light grey. Accents are gold (#D4A853) and crimson (#B71C1C).
- Never show font names, pixel sizes, or CSS code as visible text.

Professional, high-fidelity, pixel-perfect web application screenshot. French national data analytics dashboard. Landscape 16:9, 2688x1536 desktop viewport.

DESIGN DIRECTION: GLASSMORPHISM. Soft gradient background shifting from pale lavender (#EDE9FE) top-left to pale rose (#FFF1F2) bottom-right. Cards are semi-transparent white (rgba 255,255,255,0.7) with frosted glass blur effect and subtle white borders. Feels like Apple Vision Pro meets a modern data dashboard.

Image 1 is the LIVE APP — extract real data layout. Image 2 is the previous design — keep the same CONTENT and SECTIONS but apply glassmorphism aesthetic.

HEADER: Frosted glass bar (semi-transparent white with blur). Left: red shield icon + 'Ouvama France' navy bold. Center: 4 nav tabs navy: 'Vue d ensemble' (active, gradient underline rose-to-violet), 'Donnees detaillees', 'Tendances', 'Articles & Actus'. Right: 'TOOLS' pill button.

Breadcrumb: 'France > Ile-de-France > Paris' in muted grey on the gradient background.

Title 'Carte du risque national' bold serif navy on gradient background.

TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT (60/40):

LEFT — Frosted glass card:
  Choropleth France map. Departments colored from soft blue to warm rose to deep crimson. White borders. The glass card gives a floating, layered depth.

RIGHT — On gradient background:
  Frosted glass card 'INDICES': 6 rows with soft colored left bars, category names, and rounded pastel score pills:
    Score Total 113, Insecurite 110, Immigration 142, Islamisation 124, Defrancisation 89, Wokisme 95.

  4 frosted KPI cards: Score Global 113 +3.2%, Insecurite 118, Immigration 142, Islamisation 124. Soft shadows and subtle glow.

  Two frosted cards: Macron portrait + elections 65%.

FINAL RULES:
- Background is a soft continuous gradient (lavender to rose). NOT flat white. NOT beige.
- All cards are semi-transparent frosted glass with blur backdrop and thin white borders.
- Depth through layered translucency, not heavy shadows.
- Never show font names, pixel sizes, or CSS code as visible text.

DESIGN DIRECTION: EVOLVED V5 — same warm beige (#F5F3EF) editorial aesthetic but with all v5 bugs fixed and significantly more polish. Crisper typography, better card hierarchy, subtle micro-interactions hints.

Image 1 is the LIVE APP — extract real data. Image 2 is the DESIGN TARGET — closely follow its style but enhance it.

HEADER: Clean white bar. Left: red shield icon + 'Ouvama France' bold navy. Center: EXACTLY 4 tabs navy text — 'Vue d ensemble' (active, red 3px underline), 'Donnees detaillees', 'Tendances', 'Articles & Actus'. Right: 'TOOLS' button with small chevron-down. The header must have ONLY these elements, nothing duplicated.

Breadcrumb strip on slightly darker beige: 'France > Ile-de-France > Paris'.

Title 'Vue d ensemble nationale' elegant bold serif navy on warm beige.

TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT (58/42) on warm beige:

LEFT — White card with refined thin border and 16px radius:
  High-quality choropleth France map. Smooth department polygons (not rough). Colors: pale cream (#FFF8E1) through warm orange (#FF8F00) to deep crimson (#B71C1C). Crisp white internal borders. Clean horizontal gradient legend at bottom: Faible | Moyen | Eleve | Critique.

RIGHT — Stacked on warm beige with generous 16px gaps:
  White card 'INDICES' — thin red accent line below header. 6 category rows with generous vertical spacing:
    Each: 4px colored left bar, round 28px pastel badge with icon, name bold navy, tonal pill with score. Subtle chevron right.
    Score Total 113, Insecurite 110, Immigration 142, Islamisation 124, Defrancisation 89, Wokisme 95.
    Immigration 142 pill is warm red tonal. Defrancisation 89 is green tonal.

  4 white KPI cards in a tight row, each with:
    Small grey label on top, large bold navy number center, colored trend line below:
    Score Global 113 +3.2% green, Insecurite 118 +1.1% red, Immigration 142 -0.5% green, Islamisation 124 +2.1% red.

  Two white cards side by side:
    LEFT: Professional portrait of Emmanuel Macron, 'Emmanuel Macron' bold navy, 'President de la Republique' grey, 'Renaissance' small chip.
    RIGHT: 'Elections Presidentielles 2022' heading. '65%' large bold navy. 'Participation' grey label. Stacked horizontal bar: amber 58.5% Renaissance + navy 41.5% RN. Compact legend below.

FINAL RULES:
- The ENTIRE page background is warm beige (#F5F3EF). Clearly visible between and behind ALL cards. NOT white. NOT grey.
- All cards white with 1px border (#E0DCD4), 16px radius, very subtle shadow.
- France map must look professional with smooth polygon edges, not rough hand-drawn.
- Header has EXACTLY 4 tabs + TOOLS. No duplicate tabs. No extra elements.
- Never show font names, pixel sizes, or CSS code as visible text.
